messages:
Maya (Product): Kicking off Q1 planning for Private deployments. Need quick alignment: prioritize VPC control-plane rollout vs on-prem packaging + air-gap certification. Customers piling in with mixed asks. Proposed decision matrix below.

Raj (Eng Infra): +1 matrix. We need to lock control-plane API contract and auth model first. On-prem packaging depends on build reproducibility.

Tom (Solutions): Customer A (fin-serv) demands VPC plus HSM/KMS integration. Customer B wants air-gapped appliance with offline installer. Both can be phased.

Priya (Sales): Heads-up: 3 near-term deals tied to VPC SLA + regional hosting. Airgap deals are longer sales cycles but much higher ACV.

Lina (Eng-ML): On-prem blocker: model weights distribution and signed artifacts. Need chunked artifact downloads + quantized runtimes to hit footprint targets.

Ken (Security): Airgap checklist: reproducible builds, SBOM, signature verification, attestation. Add compliance acceptance criteria to launch def.

Maya (Product): Proposed OKRs: 1) Ship VPC control-plane GA with per-tenant networking + KMS by EoQ1. 2) Deliver on-prem packaging v1 (non-airgap) + offline installer. 3) Close 50% of airgap readiness items and run a pilot with 1 customer. Opinions?

Raj (Eng Infra): Timeline looks doable if we scope down: core control-plane APIs, auth, per-tenant network config. Defer fancy autoscale/canary for now.

Tom (Solutions): For packaging pilot we can create a minimal VM image + bootstrap script. Need a clear install playbook and support runbook.

Priya (Sales): Also need a customer-facing checklist and commercial guardrails for packaging fees + support time. Will surface the four highest-priority accounts.

Maya (Product): Risk notes: airgap adds 4–8w of engineering + legal work for signed images and EULA updates. VPC work risks: infra ops and multi-tenant isolation testing.

Lina (Eng-ML): Suggest we parallelize: small team for control-plane core, another for artifact pipeline prototype. That reduces coupling.

Ken (Security): We'll need engineering time for SBOM automation and signing keys. Recommend adding security acceptance criteria to the ticket definition.

Maya (Product): Decision call — vote with emoji: :one: = prioritize VPC control-plane GA first, :two: = prioritize on-prem packaging/airgap. Reply with :one: or :two: by EOD.

deploy-bot: CI build started for branch packaging/q1-proto (build #452).

Raj (Eng Infra): :one:
Lina (Eng-ML): :two: (weights distro unsolved)
Tom (Solutions): :one:
Priya (Sales): :one:
Ken (Security): :two: (compliance risk)

Maya (Product): Noted split. Scheduling 30m cross-functional sync tomorrow. Action items: - Raj: draft minimal control-plane API surface (48h) - Lina: prototype signed-artifact pipeline + small writeup (1 week) - Tom: packaging pilot checklist + support runbook (1 week) - Priya: customer priority list + commercial impact (48h) - Ken: airgap compliance acceptance doc (1 week)

Maya (Product): Closing thread — will follow up with invite and agenda. Thanks everyone.
